argument: Universities should replace exams with projects. A 2021 study found project-based courses improved retention, so assessment should follow the way students learn best. Some argue projects are harder to grade fairly, but clear rubrics address that. This approach works.
Projects are never a fair way to assess anyone because every group project is dominated by one student.

Remote learning is not more effective, classrooms simply work better for students.

Governments should regulate generative AI because everyone knows that unregulated technology always leads to disaster.
Classroom learning is more effective. Research shows face-to-face contact improves attention and feedback speed, so students learn more in person.
